translations.1: And livestock, numerous, belonged to the sons of Reuben and to the sons of Gad — very great. And they saw the land of Jazer and the land of Gilead, and behold, it was a place for livestock.
translations.2: And the sons of Gad and the sons of Reuben came, and said to Moses and Eleazar the imām and to the nobles of the congregation, saying:
translations.3: that Ataroth, and Dibon, and Jazer, and Nimrah, and Heshbon, and Elaleh, and Sibam, and Nebo, and Beon —
translations.4: the land which God opened before the congregation of the sons of Israel — it is a land suited for livestock, and your servants have livestock.
translations.5: And they said: if we have found favor with you, let this land be given over to us as an inheritance; do not bring us across the Jordan.
translations.6: And Moses said to them: shall your brothers go forth to war while you sit here?
translations.7: And why do you make the hearts of the sons of Israel faint from journeying to the land which God has given them?
translations.8: Thus did your fathers, when I sent them from Kadesh-barnea to scout out the land.
translations.9: They reached the Valley of the Cluster and saw the land, and they made the hearts of the sons of Israel faint, so that they would not enter the land which God had given them.
translations.10: And God's wrath intensified at that time, and He swore, saying:
translations.11: 'The men who came up from Egypt, from twenty years old and upward, shall not see the land which I swore to Abraham and Isaac and Jacob — since they did not follow My obedience.
translations.12: Except Caleb son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite and Joshua son of Nun, for they followed the obedience of God.'
translations.13: And when God's wrath intensified against them, He led them astray in the wilderness forty years, until the whole generation that had done evil before God had perished.
translations.14: And behold, you have risen in the place of your fathers — in the teachings of sinful people — to add yet more to the intensity of God's wrath against the house of Israel.
translations.15: For if you turn back from His obedience, He will increase His leaving them in the wilderness, and you will bring destruction upon these people if they hold to your view.
translations.16: Then they came forward to him and said: we will build enclosures for our livestock here, and towns for our children.
translations.17: And we shall arm ourselves swiftly before the sons of Israel, until we bring them to their place; and our children shall dwell in fortified towns, on account of the inhabitants of the land.
translations.18: We shall not return to our homes until every tribe of the sons of Israel has obtained its inheritance.
translations.19: For we shall not inherit with them from across the Jordan onward, since we have already received our inheritance from the eastern side of the Jordan.
translations.20: And Moses said to them: if you do this thing, and arm yourselves before God for the host,
translations.21: and every armed man among you crosses the Jordan before Him, until He cuts off His enemies from before Him —
translations.22: and when the land is opened before Him, after that you shall return, and you shall be acquitted before God and before the house of Israel, and this land shall be yours as a possession before Him —
translations.23: but if you do not do thus, you have sinned against God; and acknowledge your sins when His punishment reaches you.
translations.24: Build yourselves towns for your children, and enclosures for your flocks, and what has gone out of your mouth — carry it out.
translations.25: They said to him: your servants shall do as our lord commands them.
translations.26: Our children and our women, our livestock and the rest of our beasts, shall dwell in the land of Gilead.
translations.27: And your servants shall cross over, every armed man among them for the host, before God, for the war — as our lord has said.
translations.28: And Moses gave instructions concerning them to Eleazar the imām and Joshua son of Nun, and to the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the sons of Israel.
translations.29: And he said: if every armed man among them crosses the Jordan with you for war before God, until the land is opened before you, then give them the land of Gilead as a possession.
translations.30: But if they do not cross over armed with you, then let them receive a holding among you in the land of Canaan.
translations.31: And they answered him and said to him: all that God has commanded — your servants — we shall carry out.
translations.32: We shall cross over armed before God to the land of Canaan, so that the possession of our inheritance on the eastern side of the Jordan may be secured to us.
translations.33: So Moses gave to the sons of Gad and to the sons of Reuben and to the half-tribe of Manasseh son of Joseph the land of the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites and the land of the kingdom of Og king of Bashan — the whole land with its towns, which are within its borders all around.
translations.34: And the sons of Gad built Dibon, and Ataroth, and Aroer,
translations.35: and Atroth-shophan, and Jazer, and Jogbehah,
translations.36: and Beth-nimrah and Beth-haran — fortified towns, and enclosures for flocks.
translations.37: And the sons of Reuben built Heshbon, and Elaleh, and Kiriathaim,
translations.38: and Nebo, and Baal-meon — their names being transferred — and Sibmah; for they gave names to the towns which they built as they saw fit.
translations.39: Then the sons of Machir son of Manasseh went to Gilead and took it, and drove out the Amorite who was in it.
translations.40: And Moses gave Gilead to Machir son of Manasseh, and they settled in it.
translations.41: And Jair son of Manasseh went and captured their villages, and called them the Villages of Jair.
translations.42: And Nobah went and captured Kenath and its districts, and called it Nobah after his own name.
